# CEL Old Format Regression Tests

-- old-format-template.yaml --
name: legacy
description: Old format template
required:
  - title
  - type
optional:
  - summary
body: |
  # {{title}}
-- old-format-template.yaml --

-- legacy-page.md --
---
type: legacy
title: Legacy Page
---

# Legacy Page

This uses the old template format.
-- legacy-page.md --

# ============================================================
# Section 1: akb lint fails with old-format template
# ============================================================

exec akb init old-fmt-kb
cd old-fmt-kb

# Place old-format template in .akb/templates/
exec cp ../old-format-template.yaml .akb/templates/legacy.yaml

# Run lint — should fail when loading templates
! exec akb lint
stderr 'Template format has changed'

# ============================================================
# Section 2: akb write fails with old-format template
# ============================================================

! exec akb write legacy-page.md <../legacy-page.md
stderr 'Template format has changed'

# ============================================================
# Section 3: template write fails with old-format template
# ============================================================

-- pass.md --
---
type: legacy
title: Test
---

# Test
-- pass.md --

-- fail.md --
---
type: legacy
title: Test
---

# Test
-- fail.md --

! exec akb template write legacy --template ../old-format-template.yaml --pass ../pass.md --fail ../fail.md
stderr 'Template format has changed'
